title: Phase 2 trial of trastuzumab-deruxtecan in HER2+ MBC
brief_summary: Open-label single-arm study in patients with HER2+ MBC progressing after first-line therapy.

eligibility.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Age >= 18
- HER2 positive metastatic breast cancer
- ECOG 0-1
Exclusion Criteria:
- Pregnancy
- Active brain metastases within 6 months
eligibility.inclusion_text:
Age >= 18
HER2 positive metastatic breast cancer
ECOG 0-1
eligibility.exclusion_text:
Pregnancy
Active brain metastases within 6 months

title: Phase 3 study in EGFR-mutated NSCLC
brief_summary: Compares experimental EGFR TKI to osimertinib in advanced EGFR-mutated NSCLC.

eligibility.raw_text:
Inclusion: Age >= 18; EGFR ex19del or L858R; ECOG 0-1
Exclusion: prior 3rd-gen EGFR TKI
eligibility.inclusion_text: Age >= 18; EGFR ex19del or L858R; ECOG 0-1
